users.title: Users
users.description: People who sign in: administrators, supervisors, receptionists and agents.
users.rolesHint: A role can apply to all branches or to one branch only.
users.agentHint: Agents appear in reason assignment and can use the agent workspace.
users.weightHint: Used by the weighted strategy: weight 2 receives twice as many tickets as weight 1.
users.passwordHint: Leave empty to generate a set-password link instead.
users.setPasswordLink: Send this link to the user so they can set their password:
users.resetPasswordBody: They will be signed out everywhere and receive a new single-use link valid for 24 hours.
users.reset2faTitle: Turn off two-step verification for this user?
users.reset2faBody: Use this if they lost their phone. They can enable it again from their account.
users.forceLogoutTitle: Sign this user out of all devices?
users.deactivateBody: They will be signed out and cannot sign in until reactivated. Their history is kept.
users.maxConcurrentHint: Leave empty to use the organization setting. Only applies when serving several visitors at once is enabled (Settings → Agents).
users.shiftHint: When this agent is expected to work.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.inviteHint: They receive a single-use link, choose their own password, and start with the role and branch you pick.
invites.deliveryNotConfigured: {channel} is not configured. Copy the link and send it yourself.
invites.resendBody: A new link is created and the old one stops working.

groups.title: Agent groups
groups.description: Departments or teams. Assign a visit reason to a group instead of individual agents.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: Built-in roles cannot be changed or deleted. Clone one to make a custom role.
roles.readOnly: This built-in role is read-only. Clone it to create an editable copy.

branches.title: Branches & desks
branches.description: Offices, floors and the desks (counters) where agents serve visitors.
branches.deskNumberHint: Announced on the screen and by voice, e.g. “Desk 3”.

reasons.title: Visit reasons
reasons.description: Services visitors come for. Each reason has its own ticket prefix, targets, intake fields and agents.
reasons.codeHint: Lowercase identifier used in reports and the API.
reasons.prefixHint: 1–3 letters, Latin or Arabic (A, VIP, أ).
reasons.featuredHint: Featured reasons appear as large buttons for two-tap issuing.
reasons.intakeHint: Collect only what you need (data protection). Unchecked fields are not shown.
reasons.assignmentsHint: Proficiency 1–5 is used by the “highest proficiency first” strategy. Backups receive tickets when primaries are busy.
reasons.noAssignments: Nobody is assigned yet, so tickets for this reason cannot be served.
reasons.assignedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody assigned} one {# assigned} other {# assigned}}
reasons.archivedNotice: This reason is archived and cannot be chosen at reception.

settings.title: Settings
settings.logoHint: A path on this server (e.g. /logo.png) or a data: URI. External URLs are blocked on displays.
settings.dailyResetHint: Numbers restart at this branch-local time.
settings.retentionHint: 0 keeps data until erased manually. Statistics are kept without personal data.
settings.consentText: Consent text on the reception form
settings.requireConsent: Require consent before issuing a ticket
settings.notifyTurnsAway: Notify when this many turns away
settings.priorityWeightHint: Added to the queue score. 0 is normal.
settings.isLaneHint: Served before regular tickets of the same reason.
settings.receptionIntro: Choose how fast the receptionist can issue tickets. The data to collect is set per visit reason.
settings.oneTapIssueHint: A reason with no required data issues its ticket the moment it is tapped, with no form.
settings.autoPrintDefaultHint: Default for new devices. Each reception PC can change it for itself.
settings.askPriorityHint: Priority buttons (VIP, elderly…) appear above the reasons and are chosen before tapping a reason.
settings.askLanguageHint: Sets the language of the ticket and of the voice announcement.
settings.afterIssuePrint: Print at once with a small confirmation (fastest)
settings.afterIssueDialog: Big confirmation window that must be closed
settings.receptionDataHint: To choose which data the receptionist enters (name, mobile, ID…) and which is required, edit the visit reason → "Visitor information to collect". To drop the consent question, go to Data protection.
settings.reportsIntro: Targets used by the reports, the wallboard and the staffing forecast.
settings.serviceLevelMinutesHint: A visitor counts as served in time when called within this many minutes.
settings.serviceLevelTargetPctHint: Share of visitors that should be called within the minutes above.
settings.targetUtilisationPctHint: Share of working time an agent should spend serving; sizes the staffing forecast.
settings.forecastHistoryDaysHint: How many past days the forecast averages (7 to 90).
settings.alertsIntro: Alerts appear on the wallboard for supervisors and are checked every minute per branch.
settings.alertsEnabledHint: When off, no new alerts are raised.
settings.longWaitMinutesHint: Alert when a visitor has waited this long.
settings.queueLimitHint: Alert when this many people are waiting in the branch.
settings.agentIdleMinutesHint: Alert when an available agent has had nobody to serve for this long while people wait.
settings.noShowCountHint: Alert when this many no-shows happen inside the window.
settings.noShowWindowMinutesHint: The period used to count no-shows.
settings.notifyEmailsHint: One address per line (up to 20). Supervisors also get an email; in-app alerts always appear.
settings.notifyEmailsInvalid: Check the email addresses (one per line, up to 20).
settings.agentsIntro: Control how many visitors an agent can serve at the same time.
settings.multipleVisitors: Allow an agent to serve several visitors at once
settings.multipleVisitorsHint: Off: every agent serves one visitor at a time. On: an agent can call another visitor before finishing the first and switches between them on their screen.
settings.visitorsPerAgentHint: Used for agents without their own number in their profile (Users → agent profile).
settings.wallboardIntro: How the live operations screen looks. The logo, colours and font come from Branding.
settings.wallboardThemeBrand: Dark, tinted with the brand colour
settings.wallboardTextScaleHint: Enlarge text for screens viewed from far away (100 = normal).
settings.wallboardBrandHint: To change the logo, main colour or font, use the Branding tab.
settings.wifiIntro: Print your free public Wi-Fi details on the ticket so visitors can connect while they wait. Each branch can have its own network.
settings.wifiEnabled: Print the Wi-Fi details on the ticket
settings.wifiEnabledHint: When off, nothing about Wi-Fi appears on the ticket.
settings.wifiPasswordHint: Leave empty for an open network. It is printed on every ticket, so use a guest network only.
settings.wifiShowQr: Print a QR code to join
settings.wifiShowQrHint: The visitor scans it with their phone and connects straight away.
settings.wifiUseDefault: Use the default for this branch
settings.wifiInherited: The branch now uses the default
settings.shiftModeHint: A shift is the time of day an agent is expected to work.
settings.shiftMode_off_hint: Shifts are only a label. Nothing depends on them.
settings.shiftMode_guide_hint: Shown and used in reports. Agents outside their shift get no automatic assignments, but can still be called manually.
settings.shiftMode_strict_hint: An agent cannot go available outside their shift and is signed out after it ends.
settings.shiftEndGraceHint: Strict mode only: an agent finishes the current visitor, then is signed out after this long.
settings.shiftsHint: Organization-wide. A shift whose end is earlier than its start runs past midnight.
settings.shiftEndsHint: If the end is earlier than the start, the shift runs past midnight.
settings.shiftOvernightNote: This shift ends the next day, after midnight.
settings.breakLimitIntro: Limit how many agents of a branch can be on a break at the same time.
settings.breakLimitEnabledHint: When off, any number of agents can be on a break at once.
settings.maxOnBreak: Most agents on a break at the same time
settings.maxOnBreakPreview: With {agents} agents signed in, up to {max} may be on a break at once.
settings.holdMinutes: Time to take a free place (minutes)
settings.holdMinutesHint: The next agent in line is notified and has this long to take a free place.
settings.breakLimitExplainer: An agent who must wait is told how many colleagues are on a break, and is notified as soon as a place is free.
settings.phoneCountryCodeHint: Used to complete local numbers such as 0944 123 456.
settings.weIntro: The waiting time a visitor sees on the ticket, the confirmation and the status page. It is only an estimate and never stops a ticket from being issued. Each branch can have its own rules.
settings.weInherited: The branch now uses the default
settings.weMode: How the waiting time is worked out
settings.weMode_fixed_hint: The same number of minutes for every visitor ahead, whatever the reason.
settings.weMode_reason_hint: Each reason's own expected service time (set under Reasons).
settings.weMode_analytics_hint: Uses how long completed visits really took over the last days; falls back to the reason's time until there is enough data.
settings.weFixedMinutesHint: For example 5 means 3 people ahead ≈ 15 minutes for one agent.
settings.weDivideByAgents: Divide by the agents serving the queue
settings.weDivideByAgentsHint: With 3 agents, the same queue is estimated to move three times as fast.
settings.weLookbackDaysHint: Only visits finished in this period count.
settings.weMinSamplesHint: Below this many finished visits of a reason, its expected time is used.
settings.weStatistic_median_hint: The middle value; a few very long visits do not distort it.
settings.weStatistic_average_hint: The mean; long visits pull it up.
settings.weStatistic_p75_hint: Three out of four visits are shorter; visitors are rarely surprised by a longer wait.
settings.weWeightByHour: Prefer visits from the same hour of the day
settings.weWeightByHourHint: Uses visits within one hour of now (same weekday first) when there are enough of them.
settings.weTrimOutliersHint: Drops the shortest and longest 5%, visits under 20 seconds and visits over 4 hours.
settings.weRoundingHint: Rounded-up figures look less exact and promise less.
settings.weBufferHint: Added on top of the estimate.
settings.weMinShownHint: Under this estimate the visitor sees the text below instead of a number. 0 = always a number.
settings.weShowOnTicket: Show the waiting time on the ticket and status page
settings.weShowOnTicketHint: When off, no waiting time is printed or shown to the visitor.
settings.weShowAsRangeHint: For example 10–15 min, from typical short and long visits.
settings.weNextText: Text for a very short wait
settings.wePreviewAhead: {n, plural, one {# person ahead} other {# people ahead}}
settings.weHiddenOnTicket: The waiting time is hidden from visitors.
settings.weTableHint: Completed visits of the last {days} days, in minutes.

distribution.title: Distribution rules
distribution.description: How tickets reach agents. Rules can be set for all branches, overridden per branch, or per visit reason. Changes apply to the very next decision, with no restart.
distribution.overridden: This scope overrides the inherited rules.
distribution.inherited: This scope uses the inherited rules. Saving creates an override.
distribution.removeOverrideBody: This scope will follow the inherited rules again.
distribution.saved: Rules saved. They apply from the next ticket.
distribution.tryInSimulator: Try these rules in the simulator

pull.title: Pull (bank style)
pull.body: Tickets wait in the reason's queue; any eligible agent presses “Call next” and gets the head of the queue.

push.title: Auto-assign
push.body: Each new ticket is reserved for a specific agent immediately, chosen by the strategy below.

hybrid.title: Hybrid
hybrid.body: Auto-assign to the preferred agent; if they don't call it in time, release it to everyone and alert a supervisor.

manual.title: Manual
manual.body: The receptionist or a supervisor chooses the agent for every ticket.

round_robin.title: Round robin
round_robin.body: Each new ticket goes to the next agent in a fixed rotation. An agent who is away or full is skipped and the turn carries on.

distribution.strategiesHint: Applied in order: each step breaks ties left by the previous one.
distribution.alertSupervisor: Alert the supervisor when a ticket is released
distribution.stickyEnabled: Prefer the agent who served this visitor last time (matched by mobile number)
distribution.orderingHint: The score decides who is called next. Waiting time alone = pure first come, first served.
distribution.appointmentEarly: Boost appointments this many minutes before their time
distribution.lanesFirst: Serve priority lanes (e.g. VIP) before the regular line
distribution.maxWaitHint: Anyone waiting longer is called before everyone else, in order of waiting time.
distribution.agingHint: Extra score once a ticket has waited this long, so nobody is forgotten.
distribution.countReserved: Reserved (not yet called) tickets count toward an agent's maximum
distribution.overflowEnabled: Let backup agents help when the queue is over the limits
distribution.backupsWhenNoPrimary: Backups also help whenever no primary agent is free
distribution.noShowTimeout: Treat as no-show after (min, 0 = only manual)
distribution.noShowRequeue: Send it to the end of the queue
distribution.undo: Undo window for accidental no-show / complete (seconds)

simulate.title: Simulate
simulate.description: Replay a day of visitors against different rules and compare waiting times, SLA and fairness before going live. Uses the same engine as production.
simulate.empty: Run a simulation to see results.

multi.description: A grid with the current ticket of every desk.

pairing.instructions: Open {url} on the TV and type this code.
pairing.validity: The code is valid for 15 minutes and can be used once.

config.voiceHint: Leave on “Inherit” to use the general voice settings.

ann.imageTooBig: The image is larger than 1.5 MB. Choose a smaller one or use a local path.

voice.chime: Play a chime before the call
voice.cloudNote: Cloud voice is an extension point: it needs a server-side speech service to be configured first.
voice.voiceNamesHint: Optional. The start of an installed voice name, per language. Empty = the first available voice.
voice.phrasesHint: The sentence spoken when a ticket is called, per language. Click a placeholder to insert it where the cursor is.
voice.testHint: Testing uses the voices installed on this computer, with the saved rate and volume.
voice.noVoice: No {lang} voice is installed on this device. Use a pre-recorded audio pack or a cloud voice instead, or install a voice for this language.
voice.packsHint: Pre-recorded clips per language. Required keys: ar.phrase.number, ar.phrase.desk, ar.digit.0 to ar.digit.9 and ar.letter.A to ar.letter.Z for the letters in use (the same with the en. prefix for English).
voice.manifestHelp: An object of clip key to audio file, for example {example}. Values start with / or data:audio/.

voice.arabicHint: Choose who speaks the Arabic announcements on the screens. The change reaches every paired screen at once. Press Preview to hear a sample: number A 12 to desk 3.

voice.noBundled: No voices yet. Press "Add the bundled voices".
voice.bundledNote: The bundled voices are pre-recorded and work without internet.
